queries.excerpt: `e4m3` data format: This data format is an 8-bit floating point format with 4 bits for exponent and 3 bits for mantissa. The `e4m3` encoding does not support infinity and `NaN` values are limited to `0x7f` and `0xff`.
queries.claim: crates/aprender-contracts-staging/lean/Challenge/fp8-interchange-v1.lean:30 - range_e4m3 assumes E4M3 has no reserved NaN/Inf codes among its 256 patterns (per source Interchange.lean:33-36, 'the reserved E4M3 NaN slot')

queries.q: __nv_fp8_e4m3 no infinity all bit patterns numeric saturation
queries.excerpt: enumerator __NV_NOSAT: Means no saturation to finite is performed when conversion results in rounding values outside the range of destination type. NOTE: for the target fp8 types of e4m3 and ue5m3 kinds, the results that are larger than the maximum representable finite number of the target format become NaN. enumerator __NV_SATFINITE: Means input larger than the maximum representable finite number MAXNORM of the target format round to the MAXNORM of the same sign as input.
queries.claim: crates/aprender-contracts-staging/lean/Challenge/fp8-interchange-v1.lean:9,44 - clampMag_le / range_e4m3 model a saturating clamp to E4M3_MAX=448 (SATFINITE mode); NOSAT mode instead yields NaN on overflow, so saturation is conversion-mode-dependent
